subject: Aboard the colony ship ariadne, in the bay where the work is being done. Andrea has five in the sick bay who aren't getting better and aren't getting worse: a crushed hand, a bad back, a fever that comes and goes. Hamond has been turning up at the end of every shift with a pot, and the five have started to wait for him. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.

notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: Lamps and Broth). Read the version's text for what must be visible.
